subject: BUG-253: Operator missions write progress to house 'operator', which is not a house (OPERATOR DECISION)
description:
Found during the BUG-248 sweep by a reviewer, PRE-EXISTING and not introduced by it. OperatorEngine.js:811 calls ModuleProgress.complete('operator', 'op-'+id), but 'operator' is not in ProgressManager.js HOUSES (229-241: web, shield, forge, script, cloud, code, key, eye, dark-arts, matrix, divergent) and not in VALID_HOUSES (ProgressManager.js:1103), so awardHouseMastery can never fire for it. ContentCatalog.js:2328 and :4741 catalog these SAME missions as house 'matrix' with the SAME 'op-' id format (e.g. {house:'matrix', id:'op-python-01'}), which is strong evidence the intended key is 'matrix'. complete() does not validate houseId against any list (ModuleProgress.js:559) so nothing stopped the fork. LIVE USER-FACING SYMPTOM: HandlerDirectives.js nudgeResume scans progress.houses with no allow-list and renders 'Resume operations in ${houseName(mostRecent)}'; houseName falls back to names[id]||id, so a student whose most recent activity is an Operator mission sees the literal text 'Resume operations in operator.' on the dashboard. BUG-248 raised the page count writing this bucket from 72 to 124, so it amplifies exposure without introducing it. XP and levels still land correctly; only the house-scoped read path is wrong. DECISION NEEDED, two options with different blast radius: (a) change the hook to complete('matrix', ...), matching the catalog, one line but it ORPHANS progress already written under 'operator' for existing students unless migrated; or (b) add 'operator' to HOUSES, VALID_HOUSES and houseName, treating it as a real house, which keeps existing progress valid but contradicts ContentCatalog. My verification for BUG-248 could not have caught this: it exercised the WRITE path (mission page to localStorage) and never loaded the dashboard READ path.
[2026-09-04 04:40] RESOLVED in 9e6835a4d. 4-0 vote for Option A. Also fixed a >100 progressPercent inflation found by review (reproduced at 158%). Spawned BUG-254 extension: 3 houses (dark-arts, matrix, divergent) have no LearningPaths entry, so mastery is doubly unreachable.
